_comment: Permission settings for supervisor-started Claude runners. Version-controlled on purpose: these rules are a governance control and belong under review, not in a command line. Contains NO credentials and never may.
_allow_comment: Exactly the two capabilities authorized by MSG-0028, and nothing more. Both are narrowly scoped on purpose: the refresh is path-limited to *.md, and the push names its remote and branch so arbitrary refspecs remain unavailable.
_corpus_comment: additionalDirectories grants the A-SURVEY corpus directory and nothing else, authorized by MSG-0083 option A after BLK-0010 recorded the runner being denied that read. It is READ-ONLY BY CONSTRUCTION: the directory is added for access, and a single Edit() deny against that path covers every file-editing tool, so the grant cannot become a write path. Only Edit(path) rules are matched by file permission checks - Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit variants were tried, warned about as unmatched, and removed rather than left in place giving false assurance. MSG-0083: 'No write, delete, move, stage, commit, or repository access is granted' and 'do not broaden the permission to other external directories'. The corpus must never enter the repository.
